description: This file defines an immutable singleton class representing a JSON null value as a JSON array, specifically an implementation of a null literal in a JSON array context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a null value as a JSON array, implementing JsonArray and JsonNull interfaces.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ImmutableJsonArrayNull.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates this value is a null.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates this value is an array.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns this object as a JsonArray.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Methods to add various types to the array, but here they simply return the same instance (immutability).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at the specified index, returns empty for null array.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the array contains the specified value; always false for null array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of the specified value; always 0 for null array.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream over the array elements; empty stream for null array.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the array; empty iterator.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if array is empty; always true.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality; returns true if obj is an instance of JsonNull.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code for the null object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the null literal.
